verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an observability platform that stores logs, metrics and traces, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents retention periods, deletion of stored telemetry, or user data-deletion controls. Mentions of long-term storage (Mimir), object-store chunk storage (Loki), Adaptive Telemetry aggregation, and self-hosting for privacy are adjacent features or user workarounds, not retention or deletion controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
